stemBlocks: The graph shows the mass of antibody produced by antibody-producing cells over a period of 20 hours.
Assume that one antibody molecule has a mass of $2.5 \times 10^{-19}$ g.
Which of the following statements is/are correct?
1 One antibody-producing cell produces $2 \times 10^6$ antibody molecules per hour.
2 Antibodies are produced in response to dead and living pathogens.
